{"reason": "v1's 20 false arbitrations (rate 0.714) are mostly low-confidence events: 6/8 shown failures have confidence 0.44-0.67. Adding a high-confidence? gate (confidence>=0.7) removes those spurious triggers while keeping decisive high-confidence positives, preserving recall>=0.8 and cutting the false-arbitration-rate; frozen guard and thresholds stay intact.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
